deadline.value: Apply by December 15 of the year before fall entry (year inferred); later applications are still considered.
deadline.quote: The deadline to apply to start a graduate program in the fall semester is December 15 of the preceding year.

supervisor.value: Choosing a research mentor is called a critical step of applying; the application includes a list of prospective advisers.
supervisor.quote: Identifying a research mentor, or adviser, is a critical step in the graduate application process.

also.quote: Online form to provide personal, contact, and other applicant information, including a list of prospective graduate advisers

funding.value: All accepted graduate students are guaranteed stipend and tuition funding from a mix of sources.
funding.quote: While all accepted graduate students are guaranteed funding for their stipend and tuition

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in natural or physical science, engineering or mathematics is expected, and a master's is not needed first.
entry_route.quote: A student may work toward a Ph.D. degree without first earning a master's degree.

also.quote: For admission, applicants generally are expected to have a bachelor's degree in some branch of the natural or physical sciences, engineering, or mathematics.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study
